name: setPairings
description: Replace the desktop's persisted remote-access pairings wholesale. The runtime's pairingTable writes the FULL table after every mutation (start / revoke / a connection's lastSeenAt touch) so the on-disk copy in profile pref nexus.remote_access.pairings always mirrors the live table; there is no delta API. The single `pairings` input is the complete list of pairing dicts (same shape getPairings returns). C++ stores the list opaquely and never interprets it.

inputs.name: pairings
inputs.description: The COMPLETE pairing table as a list of dicts (pairId, secret, scope, label, createdAt, expiresAt, revoked, lastSeenAt). Replaces the persisted list verbatim.
